errors.description: The agent prematurely provides an answer without fully utilizing the available tools to verify the information, indicating a misjudgment in tool application.
The agent appears to have misinterpreted the task as simply retrieving a number, rather than identifying the player with the most walks and *then* retrieving their at-bat count.
The agent repeatedly calls the page_down tool without success, indicating inefficient resource utilization and potential looping behavior.
The initial response provides the answer directly without the requested detailed explanation, demonstrating a formatting issue in the output.
The visit_page tool encountered a 403 error, indicating an issue with accessing the requested webpage.
